commands.command:
date -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
echo DIRECT_NON_DLL_REFERENCE_SCAN
n=0
for f in /usr/apps/*/bin/* /opt/usr/apps/*/bin/*; do
 case "$f" in *.dll|*.pdb|*.json|*.xml) continue;; esac
 if test -f "$f"; then
  n=$((n+1))
  grep -a -l -E -i 'off.?sensing|el.?sensing|Screen.?Restor|Screen.?Optimi|SCREEN_OPTIM|OPTIMAZTION|PIXEL_REFRESH|pixel refresh|clearer screen|oled.?care|panelcare|panel_care' "$f"
 fi
done
echo "SCANNED_DIRECT_NON_DLL_FILES=$n"
date -u
